stories.title: PL elege 121 deputados federais e supera bancada histórica do MDB na Câmara em 1990

en.title: PL elects 121 federal deputies and surpasses MDB's historic 1990 Chamber delegation
en.summary: Brazil's PL party elected 121 federal deputies, establishing the largest party delegation since redemocratization and exceeding MDB's historical record from 1990.

stories.title: Veja lista dos 513 deputados federais eleitos para a Câmara dos Deputados

en.title: See list of 513 federal deputies elected to the Chamber of Deputies
en.summary: Brazil elected 513 federal deputies for the Chamber starting February 2027. The PL secured the largest party delegation in post-redemocratization history with 121 seats, followed by a PT-led coalition with 88 seats.

stories.title: MDB vai manter liberdade para lideranças escolherem entre Lula e Flávio no 2º turno, diz Baleia Rossi

en.title: MDB will maintain freedom for leaders to choose between Lula and Flávio in second round, says Baleia Rossi
en.summary: MDB's national president announced the party will allow its leaders to individually decide whether to support Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro in the presidential runoff, maintaining the same approach used before the first round.

stories.title: Onda da direita supera a de 2018, fragiliza Lula em estados-chave e impulsiona Flávio no 2º turno

en.title: Right-wing wave surpasses 2018, weakens Lula in key states and propels Flávio in second round
en.summary: Sunday's election showed a stronger right-wing surge than 2018, driven by a more structured PL party compared to the PSL of that era, weakening Lula's position in decisive states while strengthening Flávio's second-round prospects.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vence em 16 capitais e Lula leva 11; veja votos por zona eleitoral

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro wins in 16 capitals and Lula takes 11; see votes by electoral zone
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro won the most votes in 16 of Brazil's 27 capitals while President Lula won in 11 others. Both candidates will face each other in a runoff election scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: Com 121 deputados, PL terá maior bancada da Câmara; veja eleitos por estado

en.title: With 121 deputies, PL will have the largest delegation in Congress; see elected by state
en.summary: The Liberal Party secured the largest bloc in the Chamber of Deputies in the 2026 election with 121 federal deputies, representing 24 percent of the chamber's 513 seats.

stories.title: Setor de infraestrutura vê pouca mudança com Lula ou Flávio Bolsonaro e cobra juros menores

en.title: Infrastructure sector sees little change with Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro and demands lower interest rates
en.summary: The infrastructure sector views the runoff between the two candidates with focus on high interest rates and public budget availability for financing infrastructure projects.

stories.title: Flávio x Lula no 2º turno: direita no comando, a digital do STF e uma missão inédita; leia análises

en.title: Flávio vs Lula in 2nd round: right in command, the Supreme Court's digital footprint and an unprecedented mission; read analyses
en.summary: The runoff between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula raises questions about right-wing governance, Supreme Court digital issues, and new challenges ahead.

stories.title: Brazil Runoff on October 25, Flávio Bolsonaro vs Lula

en.title: Brazil Runoff on October 25, Flávio Bolsonaro vs Lula
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro won the first round of Brazil's presidential election by approximately 2.2 million votes. A runoff between Bolsonaro and Lula is scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: Imprensa internacional vê força da direita e cita 'troféu que falta para Trump' após avanço de Flávio sobre Lula

en.title: International Press Sees Right-Wing Strength and Cites 'Trophy Missing for Trump' After Flávio's Advance Over Lula
en.summary: International media outlets reported on the results of Brazil's first-round presidential election, commenting on the strength of right-wing candidates and their implications.

stories.title: Tem Tesouro IPCA+? Veja o que pode acontecer com o título após o resultado do 1º turno das eleições

en.title: Do you have IPCA+ Treasury bonds? See what could happen to the security after the first round election results
en.summary: IPCA+ Treasury bonds, especially longer-term ones, may experience volatility as first-round election results affect their market pricing for those who sell before maturity.

stories.title: Desânimo toma conta da campanha de Lula, abre crise no PT e Flávio aproveita onda da direita

en.title: Discouragement Takes Over Lula's Campaign, Opens Crisis in PT as Flávio Capitalizes on Right-Wing Wave
en.summary: Lula's campaign is experiencing discouragement and internal party tensions, while Flávio Bolsonaro benefits from momentum among right-wing voters.

stories.title: PagBank repassa a clientes remuneração de distribuição de fundos em forma de ‘cashback’

en.title: PagBank Passes Fund Distribution Compensation to Customers in the Form of 'Cashback'
en.summary: PagBank is returning fund distribution fees to customers as cashback, covering 62 funds and potentially providing up to 1% annual additional returns depending on the product.

stories.title: FT: Noruega é o primeiro país a propor proibição temporária a óculos de IA em espaços públicos

en.title: FT: Norway is the first country to propose temporary ban on AI glasses in public spaces
en.summary: Norway has become the first major country to propose a temporary prohibition on artificial intelligence glasses in certain public spaces, citing growing privacy concerns related to the technology.

stories.title: Quem é Lucas Pavanato, aliado de Nikolas, que recebeu mais de 3 milhões de votos em São Paulo

en.title: Who is Lucas Pavanato, ally of Nikolas, who received more than 3 million votes in São Paulo
en.summary: Lucas Pavanato, a federal deputy elected in São Paulo, received over 3 million votes, placing him second in Brazil's historical ranking of most-voted candidates for the Chamber of Deputies, behind Nikolas Ferreira.

stories.title: Taxas das NTN-Bs despencam para menos de 7% após 1° turno das eleições presidenciais

en.title: Rates on NTN-Bs plummet to below 7% after first round of presidential elections
en.summary: Real interest rates on NTN-Bs, government debt securities linked to inflation, fell below 7% across various maturities following the first round of presidential elections and a strong rally in local fixed-income markets.

stories.title: Pais e avós deixam valores e histórias, além do testamento

en.title: Parents and grandparents leave values and stories, beyond the will
en.summary: Brazilian notaries recorded 38,740 wills in 2025, the highest number on record, representing a 21% increase since 2020 and suggesting more families are planning asset succession, though planning remains concentrated among a small population segment.
